facts.text: Amansara was first a guesthouse for the guests of King Norodom Sihanouk, known then as Villa Princiére.
facts.excerpt: Known as Villa Princiére when it first opened as a guesthouse for King Norodom Sihanouk’s guests

facts.text: The guesthouse hosted Jacqueline Onassis and Josip Broz Tito.
facts.excerpt: the hotel had played host to Jacqueline Onassis and Josip Broz Tito, former president of Yugoslavia

facts.text: The architect Kerry Hill restored the property, and it reopened as Amansara in 2002.
facts.excerpt: After a major restoration by the late architect Kerry Hill, who was responsible for a number of iconic Aman properties, the property reopened as Amansara in 2002.

facts.text: The building dates from the 1960s.
facts.excerpt: The building was built in the 1960s at the peak of modern Cambodia’s “golden age,”

facts.text: Hill played up the modernist look with cream walls, green lawns and long corridors.
facts.excerpt: Hill kept things simple, playing up its modernist look with stark cream walls, expansive green lawns, and long corridors.

facts.text: Suites have timber finishes and terrazzo flooring, with sliding doors and large windows for open-plan living.
facts.excerpt: Inside, earthy and muted tones abound with timber finishes and terrazzo flooring. Sliding doors and large windows allow open-plan living.

facts.text: Pool suites have a plunge pool in addition to a courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Pool suites feature a plunge pool in addition to a courtyard.

facts.text: The Kampot Pepper set offers a sampler of Khmer dishes showcasing Cambodian Kampot pepper.
facts.excerpt: Order the Kampot Pepper set for a sampler of Khmer delights showcasing the Cambodian spice from the coastal city in the south.

facts.text: Guests can choose international or local dishes, or both.
facts.excerpt: Guests can opt between international or local, or have both.

facts.text: The spa building is tucked away from the main courtyard buildings that house the suites.
facts.excerpt: The spa building is quietly tucked away from the main courtyard buildings that house the suites.

facts.text: The spa offers traditional Khmer treatments and a signature Aman massage.
facts.excerpt: Choose a traditional Khmer treatment to recalibrate your energy and stress levels, or have a signature Aman massage to soothe muscles sore from trekking.

facts.text: Guests can join private tours with the hotel's archaeologist, Seng Kompheak.
facts.excerpt: sign up for private tours with Amansara’s archaeologist Seng Kompheak

facts.text: The hotel can arrange a meditation class with an English-speaking Khmer monk at a local temple.
facts.excerpt: a meditation class with an English-speaking Khmer monk at a local temple

facts.text: Guests arrive on one of two black 1960s Mercedes-Benz limousines after fast-track immigration arranged by the hotel.
facts.excerpt: After going through fast-track personalized immigration on arrival arranged by Amansara, guests will be whisked away on one of two black 1960s Mercedes-Benz limousines

facts.text: The hotel sits on a busy arterial road, behind a high wall that wraps around the property.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is on a busy arterial road in the heart of the city.

facts.text: A high wall wraps around the property and protects guests from the city's hustle and bustle.
facts.excerpt: are protected from the city's hustle and bustle by a high wall that wraps around the property

facts.text: The hotel is at the doorstep of the Angkor Complex, which includes the UNESCO World Heritage Site Angkor Wat.
facts.excerpt: It is also at the doorstep of the Angkor Complex, home to hundreds of monuments built in the 12th century.

facts.text: The Royal Garden is within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: Other heritage sites like the Royal Garden are within walking distance.

facts.text: Siem Reap Angkor International Airport is a 60-minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A 60-minute drive

facts.text: The hotel is single-storied, with about two to three steps to negotiate in places.
facts.excerpt: While the hotel is single-storied, there are some points of elevation—about two to three steps to negotiate.

facts.text: Amansara provides a rickshaw with a dedicated driver.
facts.excerpt: But why walk when you have a rickshaw with a dedicated driver, courtesy of Amansara?
